The benchmark creators report substantial remaining failures on expert knowledge and reasoning questions across frontier models before publication.

reviews.rationale: Prepublication evaluations document both hallucinations and unresolved reasoning tasks in leading systems. Reported improvements coexist with those failures. The evidence supports persistence, without establishing its cause or a permanent limit on scaling.
